Scout.description: A young member of the troop. A first name alone is not an identity.

Adult.description: A grown-up volunteer, leader or parent connected to the troop.

Sponsorship.description: An adult's standing toward a scout: their guardian, or the counselor who teaches them a badge.

Pairing.description: How two scouts are paired in the patrol: one leads the other, or they are buddies on the water.

Trip.description: A troop outing. organizer runs it, driver takes scouts there, first_aider covers first aid; phase is proposed, confirmed, done or called_off.

Advancement.description: A scout's progress on one badge. complete stays empty until completion is recorded.

questions.q: Who is Lior Ben-Ami's patrol leader?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Scout)-[:leader]->(n1:Scout) WHERE n0.handle = 'Lior Ben-Ami' RETURN n1.handle AS handle

questions.q: Who are my juniors in the patrol?

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Scout)-[:juniors]->(n1:Scout) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.handle AS handle

questions.speaker: thandi

questions.speaker: lior

questions.q: Who is in Kenji Watanabe's family?

questions.q: Which trips did Mele Fifita organise?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Adult)<-[:organizer]-(n1:Trip) WHERE n0.fullname = 'Mele Fifita' RETURN n1.destination AS destination

questions.speaker: desmond
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Adult)<-[:driver]-(n1:Trip) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.destination AS destination

questions.q: How many slips came back for Brackenfold?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Trip) WHERE n0.destination = 'Brackenfold' RETURN n0.permission_slips AS permission_slips

questions.q: Is there a record that Harwick Lakes is an overnight trip?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Trip) WHERE n0.destination = 'Harwick Lakes' RETURN coalesce(n0.overnight, false) AS overnight
MATCH (n0:Scout)<-[:scout]-(n1:Advancement) WHERE n0.handle = 'Thandiwe Nkosi' RETURN n1.complete AS complete

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Advancement) RETURN n0.badge AS badge, n0.requirements_left AS requirements_left
